Name: Japanese Style Grave
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][center][size=6][b][color=#980000]OHAKAMAIRI.[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[/quote]
[color=#ffff00][size=5]*** CAUTION ***[/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#00ffff]It is currently not compatible with the type of recolor mod that changes tile sheets.
Using both at the same time will either disable one of the mods, or will look strange with the vanilla-colored mod depicted on top of the recolored cliffs.
If you have any requests for this type of recolor mod to be supported, please leave a comment on the POSTS page.
We will probably work on it so that it can be supported.[/color]
[/size]
It is compatible with recolor mods such as ”[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - ReShade[/url]﻿” that reduce color without changing the tile sheet.


[color=#00ff00][size=4]The currently supported recolor mods are...[/size]
[/color]
Added in version 1.1.
"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]" is now supported.
Added in version 1.2.
"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]Blue Grass Recolor[/url]" is now supported.
Added in version 1.3.
”[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]” is now supported.
Added in version 1.6.
"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley Unofficial[/url]" is now supported.
"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23095]Soft Slow Seasons[/url]" is now supported.

[color=#ffff00]Notes.[/color]
The setting to change the color of the flame in the evaluation will not change the graphics until the farm MAP is reloaded if it is changed on the farm due to game specifications.


As a way to accommodate the recolor mod, we are re-coloring the original tile sheet with reference to that color.
The file itself is not copied and used, but if there is a problem, please let us know.
